content.title: Valid Parentheses
content.description: Given a string containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. A string is valid if open brackets are closed in the correct order.

examples.explanation: All brackets are properly matched in correct order.
The brackets are not properly matched.
The brackets are not closed in the correct order.

hints: I'll push opening brackets to a stack and pop when I see a closing one
Good! Using a stack is the right approach. How will you handle mismatched or extra brackets?
Think about what to do when the stack is empty but you encounter a closing bracket
follow_up_questions: What if the string contained other characters besides brackets?
How would you modify this to also validate mathematical expressions?
Can you solve this without using a stack?
